description:
Shopinverse is one of Nigeria’s trusted destinations for affordable USA-used laptops, desktops, tablets, smartphones, and smart gadgets. 

We carefully source premium pre-owned devices, professionally test every product, and back them with warranty and nationwide delivery. 

Join our affiliate program to earn competitive commissions by recommending quality tech products your audience will love. 

Whether you’re a content creator, influencer, student, business owner, or tech enthusiast, Shopinverse gives you the tools and support to build a reliable income through referrals.
payout_period: Commissions are reviewed after successful order completion and are typically paid within 7 working days after approval. Payments are made via Bank Transfer or PayPal.
term_and_condition:
SHOPINVERSE AFFILIATE PROGRAM TERMS & CONDITIONS

Welcome

Welcome to the Shopinverse Affiliate Program.

We appreciate your interest in partnering with Shopinverse to promote quality laptops, computers, tablets, accessories, and smart gadgets.

These Terms & Conditions govern your participation in the Shopinverse Affiliate Program. By registering as an affiliate, you agree to comply with these terms.

Shopinverse reserves the right to update these terms at any time. Continued participation constitutes acceptance of any revised terms.

1. Affiliate Approval

All affiliate applications are reviewed individually.

Shopinverse reserves the right to approve, reject, suspend, or terminate any affiliate account at its sole discretion.

Reasons for rejection may include, but are not limited to:

  • Fraudulent activity
  • False registration information
  • Trademark infringement
  • Spam marketing
  • Misleading promotions
  • Violation of these Terms

2. Affiliate Links & Coupon Codes

Each affiliate receives a unique referral link.

Eligible affiliates may also receive a unique coupon code.

Commission is earned only when a valid purchase is successfully tracked through:

  • Affiliate link
  • Assigned coupon code

Shopinverse uses a Last Qualified Click attribution model.

If a customer clicks multiple affiliate links, the most recent qualified referral may receive attribution unless fraud or policy violations are detected.

3. Commission Structure

Commission percentages are displayed inside your Affiliate Dashboard.

Commission is calculated on the product value only.

The following are excluded:

  • Shipping fees
  • Taxes
  • Payment gateway fees
  • Gift cards
  • Other non-commissionable charges

Commission rates may change at any time.

4. Commission Approval & Payment

Commissions remain in Pending status for 30 days after an order is fulfilled.

This review period allows Shopinverse to verify:

  • Successful payment
  • Delivery completion
  • Refund requests
  • Chargebacks
  • Fraud checks
  • Compliance with this policy

Only approved commissions will be paid.

5. Commission Reversal Policy

Shopinverse reserves the right to reverse commissions where:

  • Orders are canceled
  • Orders are refunded
  • Payment fails
  • Chargebacks occur
  • Duplicate orders are detected
  • Fraud is identified
  • Cookie stuffing is detected
  • Coupon abuse occurs
  • Brand bidding occurs
  • The order violates these Terms

Commission reversals are final unless a genuine tracking error can be demonstrated.

6. Affiliate Marketing Guidelines

Affiliates may promote Shopinverse using:

  • Facebook
  • Instagram
  • TikTok
  • X (Twitter)
  • YouTube
  • WhatsApp
  • Blogs
  • Websites
  • Email newsletters
  • Offline marketing

provided all promotions are truthful and comply with these Terms.

7. Brand Bidding Policy (Strictly Prohibited)

Affiliates may not bid on Shopinverse trademarks or branded keywords on any search engine.

Examples include:

  • Shopinverse
  • Shop Inverse
  • Shopinverse Nigeria
  • Shopinverse laptops
  • Shopinverse computers
  • shopinverse.com
  • Misspellings or variations

This applies to:

  • Google Ads
  • Microsoft Ads
  • Bing Ads
  • Yahoo Ads
  • Search Ads on any platform

Violations may result in:

  • Immediate commission reversal
  • Account suspension
  • Permanent removal

8. Coupon Policy

Affiliates may only promote coupon codes officially issued by Shopinverse.

The following are prohibited:

  • Fake coupon codes
  • Expired coupon promotions
  • “Exclusive” offers that are not authorized
  • Browser extensions that automatically inject coupons

9. Cookie Stuffing Policy

The following activities are strictly prohibited:

  • Cookie stuffing
  • Forced redirects
  • Invisible iframes
  • Hidden tracking links
  • Auto-click scripts
  • Automatic affiliate cookie placement
  • Pop-under tracking
  • Browser manipulation

Any account found engaging in these activities will be permanently removed.

10. Trademark & Brand Usage

Affiliates may not:

  • Register domains containing Shopinverse
  • Create social media accounts impersonating Shopinverse
  • Use Shopinverse logos without permission
  • Represent themselves as Shopinverse employees
  • Mislead customers regarding official promotions

11. Existing Customer Policy

Affiliate commissions are intended to reward the acquisition of new or genuinely influenced customers.

Shopinverse reserves the right to decline commissions where the customer:

  • Was already communicating with Shopinverse
  • Had already received a quotation
  • Had already begun checkout
  • Was already negotiating with our sales team
  • Was captured only at the final stage of the purchase journey

12. Fraud Monitoring

Shopinverse continuously monitors:

  • Paid advertising
  • Referral quality
  • Coupon usage
  • IP addresses
  • Click behaviour
  • Conversion timing
  • Traffic sources
  • Google Ads activity
  • Browser patterns

Affiliates may be asked to provide evidence of their traffic sources.

Failure to cooperate may result in account suspension.

13. Account Suspension

Shopinverse may suspend or permanently terminate any affiliate account involved in:

  • Fraud
  • Spam
  • Brand bidding
  • Coupon abuse
  • Cookie stuffing
  • Fake traffic
  • Trademark infringement
  • Misrepresentation
  • Violation of these Terms

Unpaid commissions earned through policy violations will be forfeited.

14. Network Referrals

Where enabled, affiliates may invite other affiliates into the program.

Network commissions are governed by the commission plan configured within the Shopinverse Affiliate Program.

Shopinverse reserves the right to modify or discontinue network commissions at any time.

15. Cookies

Affiliate tracking uses browser cookies.

If cookies are blocked, deleted, or disabled, referrals may not be tracked correctly.

Shopinverse cannot guarantee commission where tracking cookies are unavailable.

16. Privacy

Affiliate information is handled in accordance with the Shopinverse Privacy Policy.

Personal information will never be sold to third parties.

17. Changes to the Program

Shopinverse may modify:

  • Commission rates
  • Promotional materials
  • Cookie duration
  • Program rules
  • Payment schedule
  • Affiliate requirements

Updates become effective immediately upon publication.

18. Contact

Questions regarding the Affiliate Program should be directed to:

Email: affiliate@shopinverse.com
